reference_policy: Use each numbered source image for its own #N caption as scene and cast context only. Preserve supplied captions verbatim as commentary; Sanskrit controls when caption interpretation conflicts. Never copy reference rendering or text.

mappings.mismatch_or_note: Caption offers a devotional interpretation (the cow-named Dhenuka is spared and Balarama acts); the canonical stanza says Krishna, occupied with protecting cows, has his elder brother defeat Dhenuka. Retain the caption as commentary; stage Balarama as the actor.

mappings.mismatch_or_note: Caption says Varuna’s Jambuka name is not known; the canonical stanza says the Jambuka name became well-known in śruti. Use the canonical stanza: depict Varuna alarmed by the jackal homonym and do not assert that the name is unknown.

mappings.mismatch_or_note: The #9 caption and canonical stanza describe Krishna and the boys carrying sweet fruits home, but numbered Facebook image 009.jpg depicts Krishna among cattle. Preserve the caption verbatim and record the image as mismatched scene context; do not derive the stanza-nine composition from the cattle painting. Follow the canonical stanza and caption for the fruit procession.
